source_conflicts_and_notes: Project owner decision 2026-11-24: use current OPAIN names and route sequence exclusively; treat Moovit as potentially outdated and do not substitute its naming, stop order, service calendar or headway.
Current linked map gives headway 20 minutes; May 2026 OPAIN announcement gives approximately 15 minutes; do not encode an exact vehicle schedule from either alone.
OPAIN June 2020 GOP-PR-0034 had contingent TC1 stop rules; must not assume those unchanged in 2026.
Do not replace public curbside bus boarding coordinates with terminal door/indoor POI coordinates without stop-specific verification.
Owner explicitly confirmed two distinct T1 public shuttle stops. T1 Puerta 2 and Puerta 11 retain separate GTFS stop_ids and separate provisional MapVX coordinates.
Puerta 11's MapVX source coordinate is a bus route cue near public Acceso 1, not a named Bus Satélite catalogue POI. Do not present the assigned Puerta 11 coordinate as independently verified.
The three MapVX positions are adopted as provisional source coordinates; final public GTFS stop coordinates and curbside identity still require verification.

2020 OPAIN stop #4 was CAC Centro Administrativo de Carga; 2023 and current official diagram calls #4 TC2 y 3. Preserved latest official GTFS stop name and stored CAC as a location alias/evidence, not a new eighth stop.
Older OPAIN source names (e.g., Puerta 8 or CAC) and OSM location names are historic/area context only, not replacements for present-day OPAIN stop names.

Owner working assumption 2026-11-24: OPAIN public shuttle most likely uses SITP stops. Provisional OSM SITP coordinates assigned to OPAIN stop #4 (382A06), #5 (383A06) and #6 (194A05), retaining only OPAIN canonical names and all physical_stop_location_reviewed=false.
Street View Mar 2025 confirms TC1 wording under cargo access marker 11 (owner zoom correction). This does not equate to T1 passenger Puerta 11 or confirm a Bus Satélite boarding stop.
